***************************************************************
WITHOUT ADMITTING OR DENYING ANY OF THE DIVISION'S FINDINGS OF
FACT AND CONCLUSIONS OF LAW, RUSSO SECURITIES, INC. (RSI),
PATRICK P. RUSSO, RICHARD A. RUSSO, FERDINAND RUSSO, AND ROBERT
D. WILLIAMSON HAVE CONSENTED TO THE ENTRY OF AN ORDER FINDING
VIOLATIONS OF M.G.L. c. 110A ss. 201 (B/D REGISTRATION), 301
(SECURITIES REGISTRATION), AND 204(a)(2)(A) (FALSE OR
MISLEADING STATEMENTS IN CONNECTION WITH AN APPLICATION).
RESPONDENTS RSI, P. RUSSO, R. RUSSO, F. RUSSO AND WILLIAMSON
ARE ORDERED A) TO CEASE AND DESIST FROM FUTURE VIOLATIONS OF
THE MA UNIFORM SECURITIES ACT; (B) VOLUNTARILY WITHDRAW THEIR
APPLICATIONS FOR REGISTRATION, AND NOT TO APPLY FOR
REGISTRATION, AND NOT TO APPLY FOR REGISTRATION AS A BD, AGENT
IA OR REPRESENTATIVE FOR A PERIOD OF NOT LESS THAN 36 MONTHS
FROM THE DATE OF THE ORDER; (C) TO PAY AN ADMINISTRATIVE FINE
OF $9,000; AND (D) TO PAY THE COMM. OF MA $17,492 REPRESENTING
COMMISSIONS EARNED FROM UNLAWFUL TRANSACTIONS. RSI IS ORDERED
TO PROVIDE WRITTEN NOTIFICATION TO CERTAIN MA CUSTOMERS THAT IT
CONDUCTED TRANSACTIONS WITH THEM IN VIOLATION OF MA LAW; IT IS
ORDERED TO IMPLEMENT SUPERVISORY PROCEDURES DESIGNED TO PREVENT
AND DETECT ANY FUTURE VIOLATIONS OF M.G.L. c. 110A, AND IT IS
ORDERED TO PAY COSTS OF $10,000.
